fictionAndLimits: Use the exact fictional per-position data and state coverage threshold, breadth and mean definitions. High mean depth can hide poorly observed sites; reads are not automatically independent molecules or clinical cutoffs.
publicOriginals: Editable native light/dark SVG, original construction brief and this minimal custody record. Private scripts, source bodies and render captures are excluded.
